summary: The proof correctly specializes accepted fact 8aac56c49321466c to n=2 and A=R^2 to obtain G at least W/64 for every possible affine support rank q. It also correctly evaluates the unordered-pair contribution in each good parity class and derives Q at most W/8, hence W/64 at least Q/8. The stated Q/100 consequence and its strictness for Q>0 follow immediately, with all finiteness and zero-class conventions handled.
